data.narrative:
AAVantgarde Bio is a Series B biotech company founded by Alberto Auricchio and Natalia Misciattelli that has raised $141M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private-stage biotech firms and 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) in the Biotech & Health sector.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $268M. Peer-median valuation anchors to three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), with a median of $3.8B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales (sector median 8.1x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures, standard for private companies.

The triangulated range is $228M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.0B. The substantial spread reflects stage-progression underweighting versus peer comparables; Series B companies typically trade well below later-stage valuations, yet AAVantgarde's peer set skews Series C. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, clinical-stage advancement, and whether peer valuations reflect genuine market comparables or mark-up inflation in late-stage biotech fundraising. Stage progression alone suggests $268M; peer medians suggest $3.8B. A post-Series B valuation of $500M–$1.2B may better reflect early-stage positioning within this comp cohort.
